_about: Homepage scroll journey. Map pins are approximate storytelling locations, not navigation waypoints. The connecting line is illustrative, not a continuous cycling or walking route.

checkpoints.title: Our home
checkpoints.caption: Morningside is our home. This is where our story begins: familiar faces, new friends and the next adventure together.

checkpoints.name: Tai Mei Tuk
checkpoints.title: Two wheels, one adventure
checkpoints.caption: Next up: cycling to Tai Mei Tuk. A change of pace, a ride together and time to enjoy the journey.

checkpoints.name: Dragon’s Back
checkpoints.title: Back on the trail
checkpoints.caption: From two wheels to hiking shoes. Dragon’s Back is the next chapter: a trail to share and another adventure together.

photo.alt: Hikers on the Dragon’s Back ridge path with silvergrass in the foreground and the sea beyond

checkpoints.name: Shek O Beach
checkpoints.title: Finish by the sea
checkpoints.caption: Our final stop: Shek O Beach. Time to slow down, enjoy the company and end this chapter by the sea.
